newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kohl vows continued support for east Germany.
newsitem.headline: Kohl vows continued support for east Germany.

text.p: Seeking to allay eastern German politicians' fears, Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Friday government support for the former communist region would continue at a high level.

Kohl told parliament the government would present in the spring an updated concept for its post-unification "Aufbau Ost" east German reconstruction programme. The plan will cover the period after 1998.
He said the goal was to support investment in eastern Germany to create competitive structures. He said unit labour costs in the east were still one-third higher than in the west.
